en.t: She still rejected him so decisively.

units.source_text: 匂亲王每次总是收到冷淡的回信，心中实在懊丧。

en.t: Prince Niou kept receiving only cold replies each time, and he was truly disheartened.

units.source_text: 无可奈何，只得这般那般地责备薰君不替他出力。

en.t: With no other recourse, he could only complain this way and that that Lord Kaoru was not helping him.

units.source_text: 薰君心中觉得好笑，便装作两女公子的全权保护人模样，和他应对。

en.t: Lord Kaoru found it amusing inwardly, so he dealt with him by pretending to be the full guardian of the two young ladies.

units.source_text: 他每逢看到匂亲王有浮薄之心，必然告诫他道：“你如此浮薄，教我怎好出力呢？”

en.t: Whenever he saw that Prince Niou was being frivolous, he would admonish him, "If you are so frivolous, how can I possibly help you?"

units.source_text: 匂亲王自己也知道应该小心，回答道：“我还不曾找到称心的人，这期间不免有浮薄之心耳。”

en.t: Prince Niou himself knew he ought to be careful, and replied, "I have not yet found anyone to my liking, so until then I cannot help being somewhat frivolous."

units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣想把第六个女公子嫁与匂亲王，但匂亲王不同意，左大臣心怀怨恨。

en.t: The Minister of the Left Yugiri wanted to marry his sixth daughter to Prince Niou, but Prince Niou would not agree, and the minister bore a grudge.

units.source_text: 匂亲王私下对人说道：“血统太近是乏味的。

en.t: Prince Niou privately said to someone, "Being too closely related by blood is dull.

units.source_text: 何况左大臣察察为明，别人小有过失，也毫不容情。

en.t: Besides, the Minister of the Left is sharply exacting, and he shows no mercy even for a small fault in another person.
It is difficult to be his son-in-law."
For that reason, he kept delaying his consent.
